subject: pharmacology
title: Vitamins and Dermatology Drugs: Vitamin A, Retinoids, PUVA, Hair Drugs and Vitamin Toxicities

steps.tx: **Vitamin A** (retinol and retinal) builds rhodopsin, epithelial differentiation and immunity, so deficiency writes night blindness first then xerophthalmia (Bitot spots, corneal xerosis and keratomalacia) and measles mortality, treated and prevented by scheduled high dose capsules in childhood programmes, while excess (supplements, liver diets) bills teratogenicity, raised intracranial pressure, hepatotoxicity and bone pain. The deficiency and toxicity portraits share organs, examinations pair them deliberately.
steps.say: Too little vitamin A blinds corneas, too much raises pressure and deforms fetuses; dose is the whole lesson.

vis.alt: Retinoid mechanism of action in skin diagram
vis.caption: Retinoid mechanism in skin, from vitamin A physiology to isotretinoin prescribing.

steps.tx: **Isotretinoin** (13 cis retinoic acid) is acne's definitive drug and teratology's modern emblem: sebaceous glands shrink, keratinisation normalises and severe nodulocystic acne remits durably after cumulative dose courses, fenced by pregnancy prevention programmes (dual contraception, monthly testing, registered prescribing) because a single capsule in early pregnancy can deform ears, heart and brain. Lipids, liver, mood debate and mucocutaneous dryness complete its monitoring.
steps.say: Isotretinoin cures severe acne and forbids pregnancy absolutely; the programme is part of the molecule.

vis.alt: Ocular signs of xerophthalmia in vitamin A deficiency
vis.caption: Xerophthalmia ocular signs, the deficiency end of the retinoid spectrum isotretinoin sits on.

steps.tx: **Tretinoin** (topical all trans retinoic acid) treats acne comedones and photoageing locally (irritation and sun sensitivity coached, night application), while its oral form is ATRA from the APL lesson, one molecule two universes; **acitretin**, the oral retinoid for severe psoriasis, bills teratogenicity measured in years (alcohol converts it to longer lived etretinate, contraception extends to three years after in many labels) plus lipids and liver surveillance.
steps.say: Tretinoin on skin, ATRA in leukaemia, acitretin in psoriasis; the contraception clock differs by years.

left.title: Tretinoin
points: Irritation titrated by frequency and pea size dosing

right.title: Acitretin
points: Severe and pustular psoriasis oral therapy

steps.tx: **Methoxsalen** plus UVA (PUVA) weaponises photons: the psoralen intercalates DNA and UVA crosslinks it, suppressing psoriatic and cutaneous T cell proliferation in cabinet courses, billing burns, nausea, cataract precautions (UVA glasses for a day) and cumulative squamous cell carcinoma that caps lifetime sessions. Narrowband UVB largely succeeded it on safety, leaving PUVA for thicker plaques and mycosis fungoides niches.
steps.say: PUVA burns and carcinogenises by cumulative session; narrowband UVB inherited most of its clinic.

left.title: PUVA mechanics
points: Methoxsalen oral or bath, timed UVA exposure
Session counts capped by skin cancer ledger

right.title: PUVA territory now
points: Narrowband UVB first for most psoriasis

steps.tx: **Minoxidil** and **finasteride** divide androgenetic alopecia: minoxidil (potassium channel opener from the hypertension lessons) applied topically prolongs anagen with shedding first and irritant dermatitis, oral low dose off label rising with hypertrichosis and oedema ledgers; finasteride blocks type II 5 alpha reductase (from the prostate lesson) at 1 mg, billing sexual dysfunction, mood debate and absolute pregnancy handling fences for crushed tablets.
steps.say: Hair pharmacology is vascular and hormonal; both drugs bill exactly what their mechanisms predict.

left.title: Minoxidil
points: Topical twice daily, response at 4 to 6 months
Oral low dose: hypertrichosis, oedema, pericardial rare

right.title: Finasteride 1 mg
points: Pregnant handling of crushed tablets forbidden

steps.tx: **Calcipotriol**, vitamin D's analogue, treats plaque psoriasis by keratinocyte differentiation with local irritation and a weekly gram ceiling against hypercalcaemia, partnered with betamethasone in fixed combinations that marry speed to maintenance, while **vitamin D toxicity** itself (supplement excess, granulomatous calcitriol) presents as hypercalcaemia's full syndrome from the calcium lessons and is treated by stopping, hydrating and glucocorticoids by mechanism.
steps.say: Calcipotriol borrows vitamin D's skin signal under a gram ceiling; vitamin D excess presents to the calcium clinic.

left.title: Calcipotriol rules
points: 100 g per week adult ceiling tradition

right.title: Vitamin D toxicity
points: Stop vitamin D, hydrate, glucocorticoid by cause
25 OH vitamin D level confirms excess

steps.tx: The water soluble cast bills by deficiency and excess pairs: **thiamine** (beriberi and Wernicke, glucose after thiamine from the alcohol lessons), **niacin** (pellagra's dermatitis diarrhoea dementia, excess flushing from the lipid lesson), **pyridoxine** (isoniazid neuropathy prevention, excess sensory neuropathy from the anti tubercular lesson's mirror), and **vitamin K** (warfarin reversal and newborn prophylaxis from the coagulation lessons) each examinable in both directions.
steps.say: Every B vitamin has two clinic doors, deficiency and excess; know which drug opens each.

left.title: Deficiency portraits
points: Pyridoxine: INH neuropathy and infant seizures
Vitamin K: haemorrhagic disease of the newborn

right.title: Excess portraits
points: Vitamin A and D: pressure and calcium
Vitamin C and E: stones and bleeding signals debated

steps.tx: **Keratolytics** and topical immunomodulators finish the dermatology shelf: salicylic acid and urea soften scale (salicylism fences large surface use in children), coal tar and dithranol persist in psoriasis traditions, and **tacrolimus ointment** (topical calcineurin blockade from this batch's mechanism) treats eczema without steroid atrophy at face and flexures, billing burning on application and sun caution. Dermatology prescribing is site, vehicle and potency arithmetic more than molecule novelty.
steps.say: Skin prescribing is site plus vehicle plus potency; tacrolimus spares the face what steroids thin.

left.title: Keratolytics
points: Salicylic acid: scale and wart niches
Salicylism risk over large paediatric surfaces

right.title: Tacrolimus ointment
points: No skin atrophy or glaucoma pressure ledger
